proposed_workflow.intake: Coordinator creates a research question with a unique task_id, data cutoff, target, scope and source-quality requirements.
proposed_workflow.independent_assignment: Assign the same core question to at least two independent agents where practical; keep assignments narrow and avoid sharing another agent's conclusion before first-pass research.
proposed_workflow.provenance: Preserve original URLs, retrieval timestamp, content hash, source vintage and exact commit SHA. Never overwrite an earlier source snapshot.
proposed_workflow.disagreement_resolution: Compare source quality, independence, definitions, timestamps and methodology. Keep minority objections and competing hypotheses; no forced unanimity.
proposed_workflow.red_team: A separate reviewer attempts to falsify the leading explanation, identify leakage, survivorship bias, data snooping, regime shift and source circularity.
proposed_workflow.handoff: Only structured evidence packets and immutable artifacts move between agents. Code moves through branch/PR and exact-head CI; no agent may write to main or execute market actions.

least_privilege_policy.research_agents: Read-only public/authorized sources; no private accounts or secrets.
least_privilege_policy.coding_agents: Branch-only repository access; no main write, merge, force-push, deployment or secret retrieval.
least_privilege_policy.data_platforms: Dedicated least-privilege service accounts; no public exports of private corpora; immutable provenance and audit logs.
least_privilege_policy.market_access: No exchange trading credentials or real-money actions. Paper/shadow evaluation only after validated backtests.
least_privilege_policy.secrets: Never commit API keys, OAuth tokens or credentials to GitHub; store only in each platform's approved secret manager.

fallback_plan.when_agent_unavailable: Continue with local deterministic scripts and public sources; record the unavailable platform and timestamp.
fallback_plan.when_provider_rate_limited: Use cached, timestamped snapshots and retry only within provider limits; do not silently substitute a different data source.
fallback_plan.when_dataset_unavailable: Mark the feature missing; do not synthesize or interpolate an observation.
fallback_plan.when_agents_disagree: Retain both positions, document evidence and confidence, and use independent adjudication.

executed: ChatGPT research and GitHub repository work in current session
verified: GitHub read/write connector used to inspect repo, create draft branches and PRs; exact-head CI and fail-closed gates verified for listed PRs
not_executed: No live Claude, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, Codex, Hugging Face, Kaggle or Databricks collaboration/authentication verified.

next_actions: Create a capability/authentication test for each target platform only after the user authorizes and the platform connection is available.
Start with read-only evidence packet exchange; do not grant write scopes to research agents.
Use a common claim/source schema and commit-hash handoffs before attempting shared model training or data-platform writes.
Keep minority objections and red-team outputs in the durable ledger.
